$comment: Manifest for a VFX sub-program. The viewer reads this file as the layer and sheet contract.
name: Fire Shield - Idle v2
description: A transparent 3D globe with gentle simulated fire rising from its upper edge, small warm eruptions, and drifting cinders. The protected actor remains visible through the shield.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: Author at 512px and deliver at the 128px gameplay cell.

anchor.$comment: Normalized pivot at the centre of the shield globe.

layers.note: Translucent shaded UV sphere with three short mesh filaments on its curved front surface; the actor stays visible through the globe.
Blender gas-domain fire rises softly from seven small emitters around the globe's upper half.
Three staggered shield-surface micro-eruptions, each made from a glowing 3D core and five swept sparks.
Seven small 3D cinders drift around the globe on closed paths.

knownIssues: The render contains only the shield effect; the protected actor is intentionally absent.
